ContentElementId.title: Content element id
ContentElementId.description: Element identifier. Any non-empty string except the reserved literal `__page_context_root__` and strings PHP casts to integers (`0`, `12`, `-3`); both are rejected with `400`. The id is stored verbatim, so an author-supplied id such as `el-1` is as valid as a generated hex id. An integer-castable id is refused because it would turn the string-keyed per-element maps of a response into JSON lists.
